answer:
Below is the complete list of plant species that the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC) classifies as **“Prohibited”** (i.e., plants that may not be possessed, cultivated, sold, or transplanted in the state).  
The list is taken directly from the DEC PDF “Prohibited and Regulated Invasive Plants” (published 20 Nov 2020) — see the source for the full document:  

<https://extapps.dec.ny.gov/docs/lands_forests_pdf/isprohibitedplants2.pdf>  

The species are grouped by the habitat category under which DEC places them.

---

## 1. Terrestrial (land‑based) prohibited species  

| Common name | Scientific name (with main synonyms) |
|-------------|---------------------------------------|
| Amur Cork Tree | *Phellodendron amurense* |
| Amur Honeysuckle | *Lonicera maackii* |
| Autumn Olive | *Elaeagnus umbellata* |
| Beach Vitex | *Vitex rotundifolia* |
| Black Swallow‑wort | *Cynanchum louiseae* (synonyms: *C. nigrum*, *Vincetoxicum nigrum*) |
| Bohemian Knotweed | *Reynoutria x bohemica* (synonyms: *Fallopia x bohemica*, *Polygonum x bohemica*) |
| Border Privet | *Ligustrum obtusifolium* |
| Broad‑leaf Pepper‑grass (Canada Thistle) | *Cirsium arvense* (synonyms: *C. setosum*, *C. incanum*, *Serratula arvensis*) |
| Chinese Lespedeza | *Lespedeza cuneata* |
| Chinese Yam | *Dioscorea polystachya* (synonym: *D. batatas*) |
| Cogon Grass | *Imperata cylindrica* (synonyms: *I. arundinacea*, *Lagurus cylindricus*) |
| Common Buckthorn | *Rhamnus cathartica* |
| Cup‑plant | *Silphium perfoliatum* |
| Cut‑leaf Teasel | *Dipsacus laciniatus* |
| Cypress Spurge | *Euphorbia cyparissias* |
| Fly Honeysuckle | *Lonicera x bella* |
| Garden Loosestrife | *Lysimachia vulgaris* |
| Garlic Mustard | *Alliaria petiolata* |
| Giant Hogweed | *Heracleum mantegazzianum* |
| Giant Knotweed | *Reynoutria sachalinensis* (synonyms: *Fallopia sachalinensis*, *Polygonum sachalinensis*) |
| Golden Bamboo | *Phyllostachys aurea* |
| Gray Florist’s Willow | *Salix atrocinerea* |
| Japanese Angelica Tree | *Aralia elata* |

| Japanese Chaff Flower | *Achyranthes japonica* |

| Kudzu | *Pueraria montana* |

| Lesser Celandine | *Ficaria verna* (synonym: *Ranunculus verna*) |

## 2. Wetland (riparian / flood‑plain) prohibited species  

| Common name | Scientific name (synonyms) |
|-------------|----------------------------|
| Common Reed Grass | *Phragmites australis* |
| Marsh Dewfower | *Murdannia keisak* |
| Purple Loosestrife | *Lythrum salicaria* |

---

## 3. Aquatic (fresh‑water) prohibited species  

| Common name | Scientific name (synonyms) |
|-------------|----------------------------|
| Brazilian Waterweed | *Egeria densa* |
| Broadleaf Water‑milfoil (Hybrid) | *Myriophyllum heterophyllum* × *M. laxum* |
| Curly Pondweed | *Potamogeton crispus* |
| Eurasian Water‑milfoil | *Myriophyllum spicatum* |
| Fanwort | *Cabomba caroliniana* |
| Floating Primrose Willow | *Ludwigia peploides* |
| Frogbit | *Hydrocharis morsus‑ranae* |
| Hydrilla / Water‑Thyme | *Hydrilla verticillata* |
| Parrot‑feather | *Myriophyllum aquaticum* |
| Uruguayan Primrose Willow | *Ludwigia hexapetala* (synonym: *L. grandifora*) |
| Water Chestnut | *Trapa natans* |
| Yellow Floating Heart | *Nymphoides peltata* |

---

### How to use this list

- If you plan to plant, buy, move, or propagate any of the above species, you must obtain a special permit from DEC (see the “Prohibited and Regulated Invasive Plants” page on the DEC website).  
- The list is periodically updated; for the most recent changes consult the DEC website or the PDF above.

**Source:** New York State Department of Environmental Conservation, “Prohibited and Regulated Invasive Plants” (pdf), 20 Nov 2020, https://extapps.dec.ny.gov/docs/lands_forests_pdf/isprohibitedplants2.pdf

Below is the complete list of plant species that the New York State Department of Environmental Conservation (DEC) classifies as **“Prohibited”** (i.e., plants that may not be possessed, cultivated, sold, or transplanted in the state).  
The list is taken directly from the DEC PDF “Prohibited and Regulated Invasive Plants” (published 20 Nov 2020) — see the source for the full document:  

<https://extapps.dec.ny.gov/docs/lands_forests_pdf/isprohibitedplants2.pdf>  

The species are grouped by the habitat category under which DEC places them.

---

## 1. Terrestrial (land‑based) prohibited species  

| Common name | Scientific name (with main synonyms) |
|-------------|---------------------------------------|
| Amur Cork Tree | *Phellodendron amurense* |
| Amur Honeysuckle | *Lonicera maackii* |

| Border Privet | *Ligustrum obtusifolium* |
| Broad‑leaf Pepper‑grass (Canada Thistle) | *Cirsium arvense* (synonyms: *C. setosum*, *C. incanum*, *Serratula arvensis*) |
| Chinese Lespedeza | *Lespedeza cuneata* |
